[[File:Auxiliary_brain.png|thumb|right|The brain]]
An '''auxiliary brain''' was device that was created by [[Beemon Laboratories]] as a prototype by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. At the end of the war, the brain was one of many items that were [[Raid on the King's Ransom|stolen]] from the Imperial [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]] [[King's Ransom (treasury ship)|''King's Ransom'']]. Involved with the theft were two [[Scoundrel/Legends|thieves]] named [[Vaz Traniff]] and [[Combo]], and they were aided by a [[Voidhound|smuggler]].
